name: Rindou Nodoka
source:
Likes: Meat, sake, drinking
Dislikes: Vegetables, alcohol prohibition

[url=/c87750]Nao's[/url] mother and Tooru's class teacher. She is very interested in Tooru, but puts her daughter before everything else so she has tried her best to teach everything she knows about sex to Nao. She is a very carnivorous woman who however has a reputable reputation and she is known as "Everyone's Mother" due to her very motherly nature. She goes to [url=/c87752]Hibari's[/url] coffee shop every night for a drink, and ends up meeting [url=/c88024]Miru[/url], who becomes her drinking buddy.
